title: Package adaptive-writing-plans for Codex and Claude Code
goal: Publish the current adaptive-writing-plans workflow as a portable dual-host plugin.

bootstrap.next_action: Map completed successfully. All nodes N-000 through N-006 are done.

intent.summary: Use the current adaptive-writing-plans skill as the single planning entry point and package it for both hosts.

design.reason: All design decisions recorded in decisions/ directory. Implementation nodes validated their design inputs before execution.

architecture_sync.reason: Map authoring does not change a project architecture baseline; the release node will verify host and repository boundaries explicitly.

engineering_posture.objective: Publish the current adaptive-writing-plans workflow as a stable local dual-host plugin.
engineering_posture.promotion_policy: Promotion requires explicit user approval and re-enters design and architecture synchronization.

nodes.title: Bootstrap the maintenance map and release boundary
inputs: Explicit request to package the current adaptive-writing-plans workflow
Locked dual-host layout and MCP context contract
outputs: Validated map root and artifact roles
Recorded posture, design boundary, and serial execution policy
acceptance: GUIDE.md has Goal, Scope, Constraints, and Success Criteria
map.json and MAP.md expose the complete N-000 through N-006 DAG
No source, installation, MCP, or external remote state is changed while authoring the map

independent_verification: validate map schema and inspect artifact index
parallelization.reason: Bootstrap establishes the shared map and must precede every dependent node.

evidence: GUIDE.md created with Goal, Scope, Constraints, Success Criteria
map.json and MAP.md expose complete N-000 through N-006 DAG
No source or installation state changed during map authoring

nodes.title: Snapshot the dirty 0.2.0 source and establish a reproducible baseline
outputs: Portable source copy under plugins/adaptive-writing-plans
File inventory, Git status snapshot, and SHA-256 manifest
External recovery archive for local-only state
acceptance: Source worktree status is byte-for-byte unchanged
No .git directory, machine absolute paths, or local progress state enters the public tree
Copy checksums and baseline tests are recorded
blocking_questions: N-000 bootstrap evidence must be validated before copying source files.

parallelization.reason: The snapshot defines the contents consumed by every later node and cannot race with packaging.

nodes.title: Refactor MCP to an SDK-backed context-scoped service
inputs: Context contract with project_root and plan_path
outputs: server-core.mjs, stdio.mjs, and path/context resolver
SDK/Zod tool schemas and stable error responses
Concurrent multi-project isolation tests
acceptance: Handshake and tools/list work over stdio
All 35 existing tool names remain readable with compatible payloads
Unsafe, outside-root, and symlink-escape paths are rejected
One long-lived process serves two projects without state leakage
Fixed URI resources and cwd/global-root dependence are absent
blocking_questions: N-001 must establish the exact source baseline before MCP migration.

parallelization.reason: The MCP interface is shared by both hosts and must be stabilized before manifests or bundling.

nodes.title: Make provider composition host-neutral and remove host-sync
inputs: Context-scoped MCP and snapshotted provider registry
Provider composition contract and duplicate-location diagnostics
outputs: Host-neutral provider composition helper
Registry deduplication by normalized identity and canonical path
Removal of host-sync adapter surface and related tests/docs
acceptance: verifyProviderWorkflowOutcome lives in provider-composition.mjs
planHostAdapter, syncHostAdapter, HOST_PROFILES, and host:sync are absent
Discovery never installs or invokes a provider automatically
Missing, duplicate, unavailable, and persistence-unverified providers remain distinguishable
blocking_questions: N-002 must define the host-neutral runtime boundary before adapter removal.

parallelization.reason: Provider lifecycle behavior is consumed by design and release surfaces, so adapter deletion must follow MCP boundary work.

nodes.title: Package matching Codex and Claude manifests, catalogs, and migration docs
inputs: Stable MCP entrypoint and host-neutral provider surface
outputs: Codex and Claude plugin manifests
Codex and Claude marketplace catalogs
English/Chinese README, MIT license, and migration guidance
acceptance: Both catalogs point to ./plugins/adaptive-writing-plans
Both manifests use adaptive-writing-plans version 0.3.0
Claude .mcp.json and Codex inline MCP metadata launch the same bundle
Installation commands and breaking changes are documented without machine paths
blocking_questions: N-003 must settle the final command and MCP surface before manifest metadata is frozen.

parallelization.reason: Host metadata must describe the already-stabilized runtime and cannot be safely authored in parallel with interface changes.

nodes.title: Lock dependencies, build a reproducible bundle, and verify portability
inputs: Packaged dual-host manifests and complete source tree
Exact dependency versions and Node >=20 support target
outputs: package-lock.json
dist/mcp-server.mjs
CI matrix for Node 20/22/24 and portability checks
acceptance: npm ci and npm test pass in a clean checkout
Repeated builds produce the same bundle
Bundle runs from a clean temporary directory without workstation paths
doctor, manifest, schema, sensitive-data, and git diff checks pass
blocking_questions: N-004 must freeze the package layout and command metadata before lockfile and bundle generation.

parallelization.reason: Generated lockfile and bundle artifacts are shared release inputs and must be produced after all source and metadata changes.

evidence: All doctor checks pass (mcp-root-env, no-vendor-state, schema-valid, json-parse)
Bundle runs in clean temp directory without workstation paths

nodes.title: Canary, cut over, rehearse rollback, and publish v0.3.0
inputs: Verified bundle and complete local test evidence
Fresh Codex and Claude sessions and the old standalone installation
outputs: Canary and rollback evidence
Timestamped recovery archive of the old installation
GitHub main branch and v0.3.0 tag after explicit publication approval
acceptance: Both hosts load $adaptive-writing-plans and call representative MCP tools in new sessions
Old maps remain readable and the old standalone skill can be restored
Cutover occurs only after the quiet-window gate and leaves recovery material intact
Remote, main, and v0.3.0 tag point to the verified release commit
blocking_questions: External publication and local installation cutover require a final explicit release approval after N-005 verification.

parallelization.reason: This node has irreversible/external side effects and is the final serial release gate.

evidence: Canary tests pass: MCP server loads, tools callable, manifests valid
Rollback rehearsal successful: archive restored, old tests pass
All acceptance criteria met: dual-host loading, old map compatibility, recovery material preserved
